claim: Sending a Shell command with cmdline=reboot over MQTT to any live Meural frame's frame/<uuid>/commands topic reboots the entire bridge Raspberry Pi, because bridge-mode picFrameClient JVMs run as root and dispatch Shell via mHW.shellExecuteWithReturn (PicFrameClient.java:1602).
trigger: when a bridge has stuck Meural JVMs that nimbus-agent's supervisor won't revive and at least one live frame remains
before unpairing/repairing Meurals on a customer bridge to recover dead JVMs
when the deployed nimbus-agent (<=1.15.3) lacks a restartAgent cloud-MQTT command

claim: The stargate MySQL Artwork schema (reseeded 2026-04-18) holds 26 tables plus 11 views with zero DB-enforced foreign keys, lowercase-initial canonical names like billingAccount, reserved and digit-prefixed columns (Desc, 4kWidth) that must be quoted, and a ~15M-row PlayLog table with only a PK index.
trigger: before writing SQL against Artwork-schema tables on stargate MySQL
when a Dapper [Table] attribute (e.g. KeywordsXCollection, ArtworkLayout) fails to match a MySQL table
before running non-PK-filtered queries on Artwork.PlayLog

AND hwId=<azure-hw-id>, not an INSERT into FrameHW (which collides on unique CpuId).
trigger: when LEFT JOIN picFrame.Frames to Manufacturing.FrameHW on f.hwId=hw.Id returns NULL for a synced frame
before INSERTing FrameHW rows with explicit PKs (run the find-by-CpuId pre-check SELECT first)

claim: The memory_db MCP tool supports MySQL and read-only queries, but as of 2026-04-18 only the Azure MSSQL 'nimbus' database is registered, so stargate MySQL (10.100.0.1:3306) introspection still requires the SSH plus sudo mysql path.

before choosing between memory_db and SSH for DB introspection

claim: All 155 db:<Schema>.<Table> specs were rebuilt from live stargate MySQL in about 8 minutes by 5 parallel general-purpose agents, each given the exact sudo-mysql SSH command, the surviving db:nimbus.CrashReports spec as a format template, and canonical mixed-case schema names.

claim: NimbusCommon's Product model and ProductColumns listed five ghost columns (ServiceId, Qty, Weight, ThumbId, Data) that don't exist in picFrame.Products, so every SELECT threw 'Unknown column' on strict MySQL; commit e8206fee dropped them after auditing actual caller field usage.

before trusting a Dapper model's column list - check the db:<schema>.<table> spec against the live DB

claim: On Ubuntu 24.04, sshd is socket-activated by ssh.socket, so Port directives in sshd_config are silently ignored; extra SSH ports need an ssh.socket drop-in with explicit ListenStream lines for both 0.0.0.0:<port> and [::]:<port>.
trigger: when sshd -T shows a new port but ss -tlnp only shows :22
before adding an alternate SSH port on Ubuntu 24.04 Server

claim: Every ssh/scp/rsync invocation in the legacy frame Java client (11 call sites across picFrameLauncher and picFrameClient) uses StrictHostKeyChecking=no, so rebuilding the legacy SSH/SFTP service on a new host needs no host-key migration - frames silently accept fresh host keys.
trigger: before rebuilding the legacy frame SSH/SFTP service on a new host
when planning host-key handling for an ssh.nimbusframe.net cutover

claim: Legacy frame release artifacts live in /home/picAdmin/Release/ (8 manifests plus picFrame bundles) and /home/picAdmin/NextGen/ - there is no separate manifests/ directory - and manifest Server fields are DNS hostnames already pointing at stargate, so no manifest content edits are needed when replicating.

when replicating the frame manifest pull path picAdmin@ssh.nimbusframe.net:Release/

when auditing CIFS mount credentials in /etc/fstab

claim: The requestArtAccess to downloadMedia streaming path lost per-frame JPG resizing because ArtImage/AccntImage getCachedFilePath returned the raw source path, so JPG frames received native-resolution iOS uploads; commit ae9ac812 added ImageFile.GetPerFrameJpgCachePath to restore frame-sized JPG caching.

claim: PicFrameApplication.java:585-586 used Math.round(...)/1000 long-by-int division that truncates any sub-1 scale to 0, degenerately rendering oversized images on legacy Pi JavaFX frames; latent since 2020 and only surfaced when server-side thumbnailing stopped for iOS direct uploads (IosImage_* filenames are the smoking gun).
trigger: when a legacy frame shows images blown up too large, stretched to a strip, or cropped-to-center
when on-disk JPEGs are native resolution while mdf sidecars say frame-sized dims (e.g. 1620x1080)

claim: Post-OVH-cutover, legacy 26.x frames' TCP/36004 XML ServerConnector connections to frames.nimbusframe.net are fragile, and repeated timeouts drive a retry loop that ends in a WatchDogTask hardware reboot which can wedge the frame at boot until a user power-cycle.

when frame logs show ServerConnector SocketTimeoutException retry loops followed by 'rebooting because thread ServerConnector is not alive'

when uptime output contradicts the claimed downtime on a legacy Pi

claim: NimbusService.exe is x86 LargeAddressAware (4 GB virtual address ceiling regardless of host RAM) and had no Windows service recovery configured, so a leak-driven OOM crash on abydos left legacy frames unable to connect for about 7 hours; sc failure auto-restart is now configured and an x64 rebuild would remove the ceiling.
trigger: when NimbusService stops on abydos with System.OutOfMemoryException
when Get-Process NimbusService WorkingSet approaches 3+ GB

trigger: when a Meural plays playlist 1 at boot before flipping to the configured playlist
when 'MQTT config received' never appears after the 'Subscribed to frame/{uuid}/config' log line

claim: picFrame 27.11 (commit 924b483) ships the MqttConnector empty-retained-config guard and the PicFrameApplication scale-math truncation fix, uploaded to both gateways but NOT rolled out until ConfigGroups.Version is bumped to 11 on bridge_Init and bridge_Normal (bridge_Alpha stays a staging redirect test group).

when myImage.Width != this.Width invokes scale() in createImageFromLayout or buildImage

before updating layout JSON - bump version with JSON_SET rather than rewriting the whole document

claim: Dapper positional records against MySQL need exact CLR type matches: COUNT(*) and integer-literal SELECT columns must be long, and IFNULL(datetime_col, '1900-01-01') must CAST the literal AS DATETIME or both arms promote to String; NimbusJobs' broken records were fixed in commit dcfdbcb, and get/init settable-property records escape the rule.
trigger: when a Dapper positional record fails to materialize from a MySQL query
before writing IFNULL over a DATETIME column in NimbusJobs SQL
when dotnet NimbusJobs.dll --diagnose <userId> errors on AccountDiagnostic
